title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.

definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.

providers.name: Dropbox
providers.scope_notes: Business SSO/app-management entitlement varies by plan. Dropbox Sign is a separate API and is excluded.

controls.name: Default connection permissions: Connecting registered integrations = Block
controls.what: Blocks team members from connecting any registered (App Center) app to their work account.
controls.setting: Admin console > Products > Dropbox > Settings > Integrations > Default connection permissions
controls.plan: Standard, Business, Advanced, Business Plus, Enterprise
controls.quote: Under Default connection permissions , click the dropdown next to Connecting registered integrations .

controls.name: Block specific apps
controls.what: Blocks team members from connecting the selected apps; already-connected members stay connected.
controls.setting: Admin console > Products > Dropbox > Settings > Integrations > app list > Block
controls.plan: Standard, Business, Advanced, Business Plus, Enterprise
controls.quote: You can choose to block your team from connecting to any apps or just block them from connecting to specific apps.

controls.name: Manage custom apps (Not in App Center) - Allow/Block by app key or app ID
controls.what: Allows or blocks a specific non-App Center app (e.g. an internal or unlisted OAuth app) by its app key or app ID.
controls.setting: Admin console > Products > Dropbox > Settings > Integrations > filter Not in App Center > enter app key/ID > Allow or Block
controls.plan: Standard, Business, Advanced, Business Plus, Enterprise
controls.quote: Enter the app key or app ID. If you don't know the app key or app ID, follow the instructions below to find it.

controls.name: Team app installation is admin-only
controls.what: Only team admins can install team-scoped apps; members who try get an error.
controls.setting: Admin console > Integrations (team apps); not a toggle
controls.quote: At this time, only Dropbox Business admins can enable third-party solutions. If any team members attempt to add a team app, they'll receive this error message: ”Only admins can install team apps”.

controls.name: Revoke a member-linked app (team API)
controls.what: Revokes an app that a team member linked to their own account; requires a team-authorized admin app with sessions.modify.
controls.quote: route linked_apps/revoke_linked_app (RevokeLinkedApiAppArg, Void, RevokeLinkedAppError) "Revoke a linked application of the team member." attrs auth = "team" scope = "sessions.modify"

controls.name: Single sign-on (SSO): Required
controls.what: Team members must sign in through the IdP, so new OAuth authorizations require an IdP login; already-linked devices keep working.
controls.setting: Admin console > Settings > Authentication > Single sign-on (SSO) > Required
controls.quote: Required (for production): Team members must log in to Dropbox using SSO, and their Dropbox password will no longer work. Admins can still use their Dropbox admin credentials to log in.

no_control.what: Blocking an app does not revoke existing connections to it.
no_control.quote: Blocking apps doesn’t disconnect team members who are already connected to an app.

no_control.what: Some calendar/contacts integrations cannot be blocked.
no_control.quote: Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar and Contacts are allowed by default and can’t be blocked, even if you choose to block your team from connecting to any apps.

no_control.what: Apps members linked individually cannot be managed from the App permissions page (only via activity log / team API).
no_control.quote: Individually connected apps cannot be managed from the app permissions page. However, you can manage these apps via your team's activity log.

controls_unknown: Default value of "Connecting registered integrations" (allow vs block) is not stated.
Whether switching SSO to Required revokes existing OAuth access/refresh tokens; docs only say linked devices keep working.
No admin control found to restrict OAuth scope or force app-folder-only access, set token lifetime, or IP-restrict API calls.
Exact plan coverage of the team linked-apps API endpoints is not stated in the spec.

authentication.summary: OAuth 2.0 bearer for user/team access, with PKCE and scopes. App key/secret identifies the OAuth application.

federation.details: Delegated user/team authorization is documented; no general external workload-token exchange established for file APIs.

ip_restriction.boundary: No general per-token or tenant API source-IP allowlist established in the reviewed public docs.

renewal.summary: Offline refresh tokens do not expire automatically; revocation and continued approval still apply.

administration.summary: OAuth scopes, app-folder vs full-Dropbox access, team app approval/blocking, unlink/revoke app credentials.
administration.conditions: Business SSO/app-management entitlement varies by plan. Dropbox Sign is a separate API and is excluded.

inventory.details: POST /2/team/linked_apps/list_members_linked_apps lists apps linked to members' accounts but does not list team-linked apps.

expiry.api: Read expires_in from the /oauth2/token response (authorization_code or refresh_token grant)

usage.ui: Admin console > Activity; filter by Date, Activities, People
usage.api: team_log/get_events (scope events.read, Team Auditing); filter results on actor.app.app_id / details.app_info.app_id

reads.api: team_log/get_events with event_type=file_download (not combinable with category)

token_format.notes: Short-lived access tokens plus optional refresh token (token_access_type=offline). No prefix documented in fetched Dropbox docs. GitHub secret scanning covers 'Dropbox Access Token' and 'Dropbox Short-Lived Access Token' (partner + push protection).

log_sources.name: Dropbox team activity log (team_log/get_events)
log_sources.notes: Team admin API, scope events.read, 'Team Auditing' permission. Records app link/unlink and actions taken via API (origin.access_method = api). Does not log every API read. Retention not established.

log_sources.name: team linked_apps/list_members_linked_apps
log_sources.notes: Inventory of apps linked by team members (scope sessions.list). Excludes team-linked apps.

credential_id_fields.notes: API request ID (dbarid:...) when the action came through the API
Set when the actor is an app (ActorLogInfo.app)

lifecycle_events.notes: (apps) Linked app for member: user granted OAuth
(apps) Linked app for team: team-scoped app authorized

anomaly_cues: app_link_user for an app_id never seen in the team before, especially followed soon by bulk file/sharing events with access_method api
API-origin events from a new country or IP for a member who rarely uses integrations
app_link_user shortly after a password reset or sign-in from a new location
Many members linking the same unfamiliar app_id within a short window (consent phishing)
API-origin activity for a member after offboarding or suspension

containment.steps: Admin: POST team/linked_apps/revoke_linked_app (app_id + team_member_id) or revoke_linked_app_batch; app owner: auth/token/revoke with the token; user: unlink in account settings. Rotate the app secret if the app key/secret leaked. Blocking the app in App permissions does not disconnect existing users.
containment.notes: Docs do not say whether unlinking immediately invalidates issued short-lived access tokens; token/revoke disables only the token used for the call.

sample_query.query: POST https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/team_log/get_events {"limit": 1000, "category": "apps"}  -- then page with get_events/continue and group by details.app_info.app_id, actor.user.account_id
sample_query.purpose: List all app link/unlink events to find newly authorized OAuth apps per member.

unknown: Whether revoke_linked_app or app_unlink kills already-issued access tokens immediately
User agent field in team_log (none found)
Exact serialized shape of origin.access_method for app-originated calls (only api.request_id documented)

calls.reveals: File contents from a user's Dropbox
calls.log_notes: Team activity log (team_log/get_events) has a file_download event; actor can be an Application and origin access_method api with a request ID. Docs do not explicitly promise every API download emits it.
